headline: Circulation is constant delivery—blood carries oxygen, nutrients, and messages to every cell
universal_truth: Distribution matters as much as production; getting resources where they're needed is half the job
fun_facts: Your blood travels about 12,000 miles per day through blood vessels
The heart beats about 100,000 times per day, pumping 2,000 gallons of blood
If you laid out all your blood vessels end to end, they'd circle Earth more than twice
discussion_questions: What circulates through your life—information, energy, resources?
Where are there bottlenecks in your 'circulation'?
How do you ensure important things reach where they're needed?

hook.title: Welcome
hook.script: Right now, your heart is pushing blood through 60,000 miles of vessels. Every cell receives oxygen and fuel, every 20 seconds, continuously. Circulation is life's logistics system—constantly delivering what's needed where it's needed.

options.text: I want to learn something new
options.response: Perfect. Curiosity is the first step to understanding. Let's explore this together.
That curiosity is exactly what we need. Let's dive in and discover something amazing.

cliff.title: The Question
cliff.script: Your lungs capture oxygen, your gut absorbs nutrients—but those are useless without delivery. What does circulation teach us about systems?

options.text: Production without distribution is useless—resources must reach where they're needed; circulation is the logistics that makes production valuable
options.response: Yes. The best oxygen in lungs is worthless if it doesn't reach muscles. Distribution is half the value chain. Circulation ensures resources arrive where needed.
Oxygen is one cargo, but blood also carries nutrients, hormones, waste, and immune cells...

q1.title: Continuous Delivery
q1.script: Circulation never stops. Cells can't store much—they need constant resupply. The heart pumps continuously, arteries deliver, veins return. Life requires uninterrupted logistics.
q1.prompt: What's your first impression of "Continuous Delivery"?

options.text: This confirms what I already knew
options.response: Great foundation! Now let's build on that knowledge with something you might not expect...
Perfect starting point! This insight will connect to even more surprising facts ahead.

q2.title: Multi-Cargo System
q2.script: Blood carries many cargos: oxygen, glucose, hormones, antibodies, waste products. One system, multiple functions. Efficient circulation means efficient everything.
q2.prompt: How does this connect to what you already know?

options.response: Exactly. These connections are how knowledge becomes understanding.

options.text: I need to think about this more
options.response: That's a good instinct. Deep understanding takes time. The next fact will help clarify.

q3.title: Bottlenecks and Blockages
q3.script: Blocked vessels cause heart attacks and strokes—resources can't reach destinations. Any circulation system can bottleneck. Identifying and clearing blockages is critical for flow.
q3.prompt: What surprises you most about this?

options.text: I never thought about it this way
options.response: That shift in perspective is exactly the point. New angles reveal new truths.
That's learning in action. When understanding shifts, you're really getting it.

wisdom.title: Today's Wisdom
wisdom.script: Here's today's wisdom: Distribution matters as much as production. Getting resources where they're needed is half the job. Ensure smooth circulation.
wisdom.prompt: What resonates most with you today?

options.response: That central truth will stay with you. Let it guide your thinking.
Application is where knowledge becomes wisdom. That's the real learning.

outro.title: See You Tomorrow
outro.script: That's Day 243—the last day of August! Tomorrow, we start September with turning food into fuel. Until then, appreciate your circulation working silently.
outro.prompt: Before you go—what will you take from today?

options.response: Reflection deepens learning. Let these ideas simmer in your mind.
Teaching others is the best way to learn. You've already begun the ripple.

growTrack.title: Circulation Check - What's Flowing?
growTrack.learning_objective: Identify circulation systems in your life
growTrack.activity: What circulates in your life—money, information, energy, attention? Where does it flow smoothly? Where are there bottlenecks? Clearing blockages in your personal circulation improves everything downstream.
